stretchedBillboard.description: quads stretched along velocity (streaks, sparks, flame tongues)

meshParticle.description: each particle is a ribbon mesh (swirls, arcs, rings); defines the silhouette of strokes

flipbook.description: texture sheet animation over lifetime (cel flame/smoke/stroke wipes)

additiveBlend.description: additive blending for glows and strokes

alphaBlend.description: straight alpha blending for cel flames, smoke, ink

hdrTint.description: material tint above 1.0; only visible as extra glow when bloom exists

bloom.description: post bloom on HDR values; the anime glow look depends on it

tonemapNeutral.description: Neutral tonemapping of the HDR image

worldSpace.description: particles stay where spawned while the emitter moves (trails)

rateOverDistance.description: emission proportional to emitter travel distance

rotationOverLifetime.description: spinning particles (mesh spin is the swirl motion)

orbitalVelocity.description: positions orbit the layer Y axis (vortex motion)

radialVelocity.description: positions pushed away from the layer origin

attachedFollow.description: role "attached": the system transform follows a moving entity every frame (buffs/auras, SCHEMA §5)

demo.note: non-normative preview scene; not part of the effect
